text.tspan: Cache-first acquisition and live refresh share one rule: return the best snapshot with an explicit truth label, never an empty lie.
CACHE FIRST; LIVE INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY WHEN AUTHORIZED
Caller timeout / abort stops only that caller's wait; it never cancels shared hydration or validation.
v2/query.execute -> result metadata + row pages + query.complete
serial H0-H7 + T1 digest + lazy definitions
separate source; catalog-wide FIFO across section keys
ONE ACTIVE QUERY PER PHYSICAL CONNECTION
fence epoch -> recycle source -> no cross-key publication
